map_role: six asymmetrically stepped dry colonial machine districts on a descending geology-controlled cascade
macro_topology: six unequal topographic platforms descend through a dry geological staircase to a raised east relief apron, separated by broad open air gaps
density_profile: alternating entered machinery halls, open transfer gaps and partly unfinished lower verandas; no obligatory filler in the expansion volumes

alternatives: high clear-sky bypass above all stepped thresholds
open lower transfer spaces below piers and between adjacent districts

unfinished but deliberate lower side verandas
interesting_relationships: west civilian/medical decks occupy higher land than quarantine and freight
workstation families alternate with broader open transition voids
natural terrain changes set deck height and pier length

procedural_exemplar_value: Supports rule derivation for variable-height geomorphic platforms, fixed material-pier grounding, asymmetric industrial machine families, and intentionally editable lower verandas.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Copperwake Fault's underground three-cavity settlements, Penumbral Sink's central ring, and Vela Rift's opposed wind-sails, this map is an unbalanced dry topographic cascade of small human-scale facilities, with terrain height controlling support lengths and transitions.
